description: Anchor format with $anchor/$concept/$datatype attribute objects vs. flat JSON. Tests whether the Anchor parser correctly extracts position, type, status, flow, and temperature from the Anchor attribute hierarchy and maps them across formats.
notes: Full overlap between Anchor and simple JSON. FlowRate maps to VEL (velocity/flow), Temperature maps to THERM. The Anchor side uses nested attribute objects with $concept, $datatype, $value, $unit fields.
